mapper.select: SELECT d.id FROM destinations d WHERE d.is_public = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM destination_translations dt WHERE dt.destination_id = d.id AND dt.name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(dt.name) != '' ) ORDER BY d.id
SELECT ti.id, ti.content_type FROM travel_info ti JOIN info_categories ic ON ic.id = ti.category_id WHERE ic.is_visible = 1 ORDER BY ti.id
SELECT id FROM events ORDER BY id
SELECT p.id FROM user_posts p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_moderations cm WHERE cm.target_type = 'POST' AND cm.target_id = p.id AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE' ) ORDER BY p.id

SELECT c.id FROM courses c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_moderations cm WHERE cm.target_type = 'COURSE' AND cm.target_id = c.id AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE' ) ORDER BY c.id
